name: Borja Giménez Larraz - Après le § 22 - Am 29
title: REPORT on the housing crisis in the European Union with the aim of proposing solutions for decent, sustainable and affordable housing
part_text: 22a. Calls for the introduction of an annual property tax at a rate of 1 % on real estate with a total value of over EUR 2 million for both natural and legal persons, providing that the related revenues are used by Member States in the context of developing a socially just housing policy;
